title: How a stranger's advice helped Tiffany Haddish go from living in her car to bying 17 properties
summary_full: Tiffany Haddish went from experiencing homelessness and living on a $500-a-month budget to building a real estate portfolio of about 17 properties. She credits advice from an accountant she met during a trip to China and Japan for changing her approach to money. She also used acting pay cheques to buy and pay off property.
